symptom: A Data grid 2 control-bar button opening a page with the grid's selection had no spelling that built: `show page M.Detail(OrderParam = $currentObject)` is MDL-BUTTON01 (CE1571, not row-scoped), `OrderParam = $dgOrders` — what MDL-BUTTON01's own hint suggested — was MDL-PAGEARG01 "a widget's page argument is always the enclosing context object", and no argument is mx check `[CE1571] "No argument has been selected for parameter 'OrderParam'"`
cause: mxcli wrote show page arguments only as the inferred empty mapping (#296) or, since #1403, a PageVariable naming a page/snippet parameter; it had no third form, so the guard (correctly, for what could be written) refused `$grid`. The control bar also had no context of its own: the engine builds a widgets slot's children directly (applyChildSlots), never through the `controlbar` node, so a rule hung on that node in buildWidgetV3 is never reached for Data grid 2
insight: No Studio Pro reference for the shape existed in the corpus (12 PageParameterMappings, none with Variable.Widget — the scanner's control was counting all 12 first, since bson v2 decodes nested docs as bson.D and a first scan silently matched nothing). Three mxbuild 11.12.5 builds of the same script settled the storage: Variable{Widget: grid} with Argument "" → 0 errors, Argument "$grid" → CE0115, no mapping → CE1571; the microflow path's Expression form does NOT carry over to a page mapping. A runtime check then showed the binding means what it says: the button is disabled until a row is selected and opens the detail with the selected (second) row. Wrong turn to skip: a builder unit test that sets argCtx and calls buildClientActionV3 passed while exec still refused — test the engine's applyChildSlots, where Data grid 2's control bar is actually built
